encoding.pixel: RGBA16F (half) OpenEXR, ZIP lossless; texel RGB = position offset from the rest pose in glTF/Godot mesh space (Y up, facing -Z), metres; A = 1.0 (unused)
encoding.rows: texel row = start_row + frame * rows_per_frame + block; row 0 = first (top) scanline = texelFetch y 0
encoding.uv2: TEXCOORD_1 (Godot UV2): x = (column + 0.5) / width, y = block + 0.5 (0.5 when rows_per_frame == 1); column = floor(UV2.x * width), block = floor(UV2.y)
encoding.normals: not baked; derive flat face normals in the fragment shader (dFdx/dFdy)

aabb.note: union over rest + all frames (glTF space); use as custom_aabb (+margin)
